newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Eastern shares priced at upper-end of range.
newsitem.headline: China Eastern shares priced at upper-end of range.

text.p: China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd has priced its new share flotation at HK$1.38 per H-share and US$18 per American Depository Share, global co-ordinator Morgan Stanley Asia Ltd said on Monday.

The price was fixed at the upper limit of a subscription range of between HK$1.22 and HK$1.38 per H-share in Hong Kong public offering or between US$16 and US$18 per ADS, which each represent 100 of the company's H-shares.

A press release would be sent later on Monday regarding the subscription level of the combined offering of 1.4 billion shares, said a spokesman at Morgan Stanley, which is also the sponsor and lead manager of the issue.
The offering includes three tranches -- the Hong Kong public offering representing 10 percent of the total, and the U.S. and international offerings representing 45 percent each.
Based on an offering price of HK$1.38 per H-share the company's market capitalisation will be HK$1.93 billion, the offering document said.
The offering price represents a prospective price/earnings (P/E) multiple of 10.6 times on a fully diluted basis, and 8.1 times on a weighted average basis.

Trading in the ADS on the New York Stock Exchange is scheduled to commence on February 4. Dealing in the H-shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange is scheduled to commence on February 5, the document said.
